plugins.name: azclaude
plugins.description:
AZCLAUDE is a complete AI coding environment for Claude Code. It installs 40 commands, 10 auto-invoked skills, 15 specialized agents, 5 hooks, a real-time pipeline visualizer, and a persistent memory system — in one command.

Key features:
• Memory across sessions — goals.md + checkpoints injected automatically before every session
• Self-improving loop — /reflect fixes stale CLAUDE.md rules, /reflexes learns from tool-use patterns, /evolve creates agents from git evidence
• Autonomous copilot mode — /copilot runs a three-tier team (orchestrator → problem-architect → milestone-builder) across sessions until the product ships
• Spec-driven workflow — /constitute writes project rules, /spec writes structured ACs, /analyze detects plan drift and ghost milestones, /blueprint traces every milestone to a spec
• Security layer — 111-rule environment scan (/sentinel), pre-write secret blocking, pre-ship credential audit
• Progressive levels 0–10 — start with CLAUDE.md, grow into multi-agent pipelines and self-evolving environments
• Zero dependencies — no npm packages, no external APIs, no vector databases. Plain markdown files and Claude Code's native architecture.
• Smart install — npx azclaude-copilot@latest auto-detects first install vs upgrade vs verify. Context-aware onboarding shows the right next command for your project state.

Example use cases:
• /setup — scan an existing project, detect stack + domain + scale, fill CLAUDE.md, generate project-specific skills and agents automatically
• /copilot "Build a compliance SaaS with trilingual support" — walk away, come back to working code across multiple sessions
• /sentinel — run a scored security audit (0–100, grade A–F) across hooks, permissions, MCP servers, agent configs, and secrets
• /evolve — detect gaps in the environment, generate new skills and agents from git co-change evidence, report score delta (e.g. 42/100 → 68/100)
• /constitute — write your project's constitution (non-negotiables, architectural commitments, definition of done) — gates all future AI actions
• /analyze — cross-artifact consistency check: ghost milestones, spec vs. code drift, unplanned commits
• /reflect — find stale, missing, or contradicting rules in CLAUDE.md and propose exact fixes
• /debate "REST vs GraphQL for this project" — adversarial evidence-based decision with order-independent scoring, logged to decisions.md
